description: Full-text, typo-tolerant search across 14M+ USPTO trademark records. Use this to find existing marks by name. Filter by class to scope to relevant goods/services, and by status to exclude dead marks.

live_only.description: Only return registered/live marks (status 800). Defaults to false.

query.description: Mark name or text to search for, e.g. 'nike'

trademark_class.description: Nice class 1-45 to scope results, e.g. '9' for software

name: search_trademarks
title: Search US trademarks
